values./items/@0f6c8fcadfbe94bc/system/effect: Boosted Focused Institute Laser Rifle (Boosted Capacitor, Beam Focuser, Standard Stock), Ballistic Weave Lab Coat, Synth Component, a large supply of Stimpaks, Wealth 4.
values./items/@462232ad78c95f8e/system/descript: Doctor Rast is a robot. He is immune to the effects of starvation, thirst, and suffocation. He is also immune to Poison and Radiation damage. However, machines cannot use food and drink or other consumables, they do not heal naturally, and the Medicine skill cannot be used to heal them: damage to them must be repaired.
values./items/@4f000755c55aa069/system/descript: Doctor Rast appears human, and any attempt to inspect him reveals him as human. Rast can only be identified after death by the recovery of his Synth Component. Rast’s Synth nature has also increased his STR, PER, and INT, and increased his DR.
values./items/@1854eacefc408fa4/system/descript: Once per combat, Doctor Rast may ‘let rip’ with a volley from his Boosted Focused Institute Laser Rifle. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 2 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 6 CD total) and allows him to use the Burst damage effect without spending ammo.
values./items/@0f315bb4f084c635/system/descript: Rast has enough Stimpaks to provide them to the PCs throughout the adventure, and he knows how to make more during downtime. He cannot run out of Stimpaks during the adventure. If he is killed, he will have 2+1 CD Stimpaks remaining on his person.
values./items/@ffed2fb122312968/system/descript: Rast carries a specially modified collapsible Institute laser rifle, designed to provide a hidden weapon for infiltrators. His weapon has the Concealed quality.
